thread:
alex_cs: Heads-up — bringing Acero Systems onto Dedicated next week. Need to finalize quota plan + autoscale knobs. Main ask: sustain 400 RPS steady, spikes to 1.5k for 5–10m windows.
maria_ops: Thanks! Do we have expected token distribution? short gen vs long chat?
alex_cs: Mostly short completions (avg 60 tokens), ~10% chat sessions with 800+ tokens. Peak spike is product release traffic.
sam_platform: For 400 RPS steady we should reserve pool with 6 GPUs (A10x or similar) and set max_burst to +50% for 15m. Autoscaler policy I suggest: metric = serving.latency_95; scale_up_threshold=300ms; scale_down_threshold=120ms; cooldown_up=60s; cooldown_down=600s.
jess_se: Agreed on metrics. Also recommend prefix KV cache priming during warmup to avoid cold-start token penalties. We should run a 30m soak with realistic KV patterns.
alex_cs: Good call. Can we run a closed load test tomorrow 09:00 PT? Want to validate fallbacks to smaller quantized model when delayed.
sam_platform: I can schedule a run. What script do you want to use?
jess_se: Use loadtest-runner v2.3.4. Sample command:
```
./loadtest-runner --target http://dedicated-acero.internal/generate \n  --rps 1500 --duration 600 --concurrency 200 \n  --payload-file ./payloads/acero_short.json \n  --kv-warmup true
```
maria_ops: Note: we'll need quota bump for Acero's account to cover the peak. Alex, remind me of their committed capacity in the contract?
alex_cs: They committed to 300 RPS reserved, with on-demand for overage. Need to propose a temporary surge window (3 days) to validate autoscale and then adjust reserved to 450.
maria_ops: I'll open a request to finance for the temporary surge credit and flag renewal risk if they expect sustained >300.
sam_platform: For the fallback tests, we should define a compatible smaller model id (e.g., redwood/gpt-small-q4) and ensure route policy has immediate fallback on >750ms. Also add response sampling to detect quality regressions.
jess_se: Adding evaluation hooks: send 1% of fallback responses to the eval pipeline with the special tag acero:fallback-test.
alex_cs: Perfect. Can someone own the runbook? Steps, rollback, who to ping on perf regressions?
maria_ops: I'll draft the runbook and post here by EOD. Owner: maria_ops. Oncall for the run: sam_platform. Alex will coordinate customer access.
sam_platform: I'll also pre-create the reserved pool and set autoscaler in staging. If green, promote to prod during the test window.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: reserved-pool/acero-test -> staging at 3135792480 by sam_platform :rocket:
alex_cs: Thanks — pls add a Slack alert to #eng-runtime and a pager entry if latency_99 > 1.2s for >2min.
jess_se: Also capture per-route token cost and per-request cache hit rate to report post-test.
maria_ops: Got it. Postmortem checklist: perf numbers, fallback counts, error rates, customer feedback.
alex_cs: OK. Tomorrow 09:00 PT. I'll loop in the customer with dial-in and test payloads. :thumbsup:
